quote: Come now, have courage to be wise: begin: / You’re halfway over when you once plunge in: / He who puts off the time for mending, stands / A clodpoll by the stream with folded hands, / Waiting till all the water be gone past; / But it runs on, and will, while time shall last.
source: Horace, Epistles, Book I, Epistle 2, to Lollius, lines 40 to 43 (trans. John Conington, 1870)
